EmailTemplate.name: Outgoing Approval Request - MidMarket or Enterprise
EmailTemplate.subject: Approval Required: {!Opportunity.Name}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello Mike,
Your approval has been requested for the following Outgoing Referral: {!Opportunity.Name}
You can approve or reject the request directly in Salesforce by going to the Opportunity and clicking the "Approve or Reject" button.
If you have any questions, please reach out to {!Opportunity.OwnerFullName}.
